label: human-8v8-1
shape: 5v5: our 2 seats + 3 Apex v0.3.0 seats (all five at +50% income) against 5 people
people: Against us: Gabiiiiiii7 (36), apexearth (31; author of Apex, he hosted the three Apex seats on our side while playing against us), SSFA (17), drakcore (11), [Crd]TimmyT (8). Spectators: computer_whisperer (the user, hosting) and Permisssion. In play the five were Armada, Cortex and two Legion, the Legion in the north-east F1-H2 (the start script lists all five as Armada).
our_side: South box (z 6,554-8,192). t5 Legion at D8 (record-0, bright red 'Yeba') and t9 Cortex at F7 (record-4, dark red 'Nightmare'), lobby side Random, handicap 50 (+50% income). Each seat had an Opus 5.5 medium player, under one Opus 5.5 high commander (68 turns, 46 directions, 6 chat lines). Hands: the pianist on Jev 1.14.0. Allies: three Apex v0.3.0 seats, also at +50%.
summary: A ranked 5v5 on Altored Divide: our Legion (t5) and Cortex (t9) seats and three Apex seats, all at +50%, in the south against five people (rated 36 to 8) in the north, two of them playing Legion in the north-east. Both our seats opened as if at +0, held 8-15 extractors with 8-10 constructors and reached tier 2 late (t5 at 14:27, killed 16:53; t9 at 20:10; the Apex ally at 5:20), so the side fought with tier-1 masses: raids died under the B4 turrets and t9's Thugs trickled into a Legion Incinerator at G2 (its army fell from 14.2k to 6.9k between 13:00 and 18:00), while the trade stayed about even until 27:00. From 25:38 t5's Thanatos, screened by Karkinos, broke the west and the centre (the Armada commander at 35:09, 55k of D1 economy at 35:25), and the people's morale broke with them (32:48: 'there is no units at all on our team'; a resign vote at 36:31). The Legion north-east then held for twenty minutes behind jammed Bastions, hidden from our radar by a ridge, with Tyrannus gunships and an Astraeus behind them: t5's army fell from 108k to 32k at E1/E2 between 45:35 and 47:38 with nothing of theirs seen dying, and t9 piled up 697 Thugs and sent 6-10k commands a minute. The people left one by one from 44:26, and the engine quit at 57:38 with both our commanders alive.

root.what: This is the earliest minute the short win was lost. t9 had 6 extractors and 11 constructors, and the Apex allies held the spots nearby. It stopped making constructors, put the spare ones on wind and reclaim, and switched both labs to Grunts and Thugs. No seat made the tier-2 sprint that a spot-capped team game asks for, and the commander never called for one. The user's reading after the game (commit 9667cfd): 'properly going t2 is a sprint ... in a larger map with allies the gap can be covered'. As a result the side's advanced labs stood at 14:27 (t5, killed 16:53) and 20:10 (t9); the Apex ally's stood at 5:20. t9 never finished a fusion (its first was begun at 57:13). Both seats stayed at 10-11 extractors with income of 109-191 to the end, even at +50%. Everything later is the cost of that minute: tier-1 bodies fed into his tier 2 at G2, then 697 Thugs and blind tier-1/2 masses against a tier-2/3 fortress, which made a 57-minute game out of a game won at 37:00.
root.evidence: t9 note 4:30: 'stuck on 6 extractors with 9 constructors. No more constructors for now ... The labs are switching to Thugs plus Grunts'; report 4:56 'extractors 6 constructors 11'; record-4: coralab created 18:58, finished 20:10; corfus created 57:13.

their_play: Five people of mixed strength, playing mostly as separate bases. The Armada players walked their commanders forward with turrets: B4/A5 nests (an HLT, Beamers, LLTs) and the D3 nest (Beamers, later an Annihilator and a Pulsar). Those posts killed our short-ranged raiders 5:00-10:43. The Armada advanced bot lab at D2 was seen going up at 12:15. A Legion Incinerator at G2/H3 (13:00-18:00) and Cortex gunships from 14:07 punished our tier-1 bodies. An Armada Fatboy/Fido block in the west, 23:00-30:00, fell to t5's Thanatos. The people built fusions and advanced fusions; 55k of that economy at D1 died at 35:25. The decisive player was the Legion north-east, which turtled from 27:00. Its fortress grew to 13+ Bastions (reach 1,100) at E1-H2, with Soteria shields, Erebus jammers, Tyrannus gunships from about 39:30, a rail tank, an Astraeus (reach 3,100), an Experimental Gantry, two Sol Invictus by 56:00, and a nuke silo at H2 that fired once (48:26). It held from 37:00 to 57:00. The people's own words: drakcore 9:50-10:06 'help would be nice ... people just ignore'; Gabiiiiiii7 32:27 'soo late this is not eco game'; [Crd]TimmyT 38:13 'I shoulda built artillery'; apexearth 49:59 'thing is mass bastions does hold off enemies pretty well'. They left one by one from 44:26.

defects.defect: Sight was modelled as a flat circle: no sight or radar grids, no 'jammed' or 'dark' words, and the brief said 'see the shooter first (a scout car, a radar within its reach)'. So both seats planned to shell 'with radar sight' a base that Erebus jammers and the z~2,330 ridge hid from every radar of ours.
defects.evidence: commander 32:10 'a radar to see through the jammer'; K-scout-terrain-cuts-sight-and-radar: 19 of 1,984 squares of E1-H2 in the spot_41 radar's line

defects.evidence: ledger: 45:35-47:38 t5 'fired 49 shots and dealt 0 damage'; analyze #108 scene 45:35 'theirs (UPPER CASE): nothing'

bears_on.note: Tier 2 came at 14:27 and 20:10, against the Apex ally's 5:20, while energy banked unused (t9 4:56 'energy 1890/2002 ... banking it unused'). The user's post-game words in 9667cfd make the team-game sprint the fix.
t9 made 354 Thugs after 30:00 with Arbiters up. drakcore 52:24: 'it also doesnt stop building t1 units'.
Two cases: the 14:00-18:30 Thug trickle into the Incinerator, and t5 alone at E2 at 45:35 while t9's Thugs were still walking. The joint Incinerator kill at 22:35 is the counter-case.
18:00-22:00: 3.6x to 76x of his seen army with t5's mass 0% in his half; the commander at 19:40 said 'all of it is standing in our half'.
Build power stayed flat at 8-10 constructors and 3-4 nanos from 5:00 (commit 9667cfd); banks were 7.9k-10.2k at 55-56.
The Bastion fortress held 37:00-57:00 against 3x-5x of our army; apexearth 49:59: 'mass bastions does hold off enemies pretty well'.
697 Thugs, one type, against Bastions; the commander at 52:33: 'more won't help against Bastions'.

t5's body was half Thanatos (tier-2 artillery, reach 1,200) behind Karkinos, and it won the west (our player at 38:31; TimmyT 'I shoulda built artillery'). Blind at E2, it dealt nothing. The lesson is about tier-1 artillery.
First soldiers crossed at 3:02-3:16; t9's Grunts reached 166-300 from his start at 5:07. They then died chasing commanders under turrets.
Raider chases of the Armada commander under the B4 LLTs failed (5:16, 10:06). Three commanders killed from Thanatos range at 35:09-37:08 broke the people's will.

In this 5v5 the allies held the spots, so spots were not the gap (t5 14:20 'every free spot left on our side is the allies''). Growth had to come from mohos and tier 2. The lesson's 3v1 scope does not carry over.
t5 reclaimed the north-west field (40k at 37:08), which lifted its income to 204 at 41:00. t9 at 52:25 was sent to the H1-H3 wrecks under the fortress.

lens.caveats: No truth file and no result row (a lobby game): his numbers are floors of what we saw, and the outcome is the ledger's. The per-match tools read only the first record (t5); t9 was read through scratchpad symlink views. wake_read was not run for t9 (it loads the 2 GB jev-4 into memory). pro_baseline does not apply (not Comet). minutes.py treats five people as one 'he' starting at E1. Some of the user's post-game words (the Thug trickle) and the main session's measurements (22 of 281 Thugs arrived; Apex lab clocks) come from the main session's memory note and commits, not the ledger. The ledger differs from the record in three places: it says 'north box', but the start box is the south strip (z 6,554-8,192); it puts t9's first advanced lab at 15:00, but the record has coralab created 18:58 and finished 20:10; it says 'no fusion until 50:00', but t9's first corfus was begun at 57:13 and never finished. The root is the reader's judgement for a won game, weighted toward the user's post-game framing (commits 9667cfd and 10691a9).

open_questions: The ledger's row says our side started in the north box, but bot.log puts it at '(0, 6554) to (8192, 8192) (ours)', the south strip. Correct the ledger?
backlog.md §c files human-8v8-1 under defect X (the old heuristic bot, 2026-09-20) and D (the enemy-start guess). This build ran the pianist on Jev 1.14.0, so X looks misfiled.
Was the slowdown the people reported (drakcore 52:15) our order storm (10,220 commands in minute 49 from t9)? It is unmeasured, and FOLLOW_STEP is unchanged.
Did the user's 'shields' (46:49) mean the Soteria deflectors? The ledger has them seen at E1/F1/F2 from 42:00; the main session's memory note has them first seen at 50:05-51:00.

How many people were still playing at each stage? Under deathmode=com a dead commander does not end a player, and Legion commanders died at H2 at 13:40 and about 45:17. The record holds no departures; the ledger dates them from 44:26.
